notes.title: Engine update and tweaks
notes.content:
Updated engine version from from UE 5.3 to 5.5. This should hopefully give more stability and improve performance.

Also adjusted the spawn rate of events. Should happen more often now.

Cheers
ICEHELM

notes.title: Checkpoint system hotfix
notes.content:
Hello everyone! I hope you all are having a good day.

The introduction of the checkpoint system in the last patch was well received, however it also introduced a rather critical bug where the player would be hardlock if they died on the last room. 

This hotfix will fix that issue.

I'm sorry for any inconvenience this might have caused.

Cheers
ICEHELM

notes.title: ENDLOOP Patch 3
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

I hope you are all doing well. It has been some time since ENDLOOP has gotten an update and after getting quite a few bug reports I have deiced to give the game some much needed love.

So in this patch there a few major fixes and added content.

New content
A whole new room has been added with its own puzzle. You might not see it on your playthrough since all rooms are randomized, but you will notice when you do get it.

Fixes
 - Card puzzle not opening door after completing puzzle has now been fixed. This was a big one since it prevented players from continuing

- Riddle room not spawning letters has also been fixed. This bug also created a softlock, but has now been corrected.

- Riddle room is now also more lenient with spelling. As long as the letters are correct the game will know what word you tried to spell

- Fixed door smashing sound being very loud. This was due to a bug that made the door slam sound playing twice


That's all for now
Cheers
ICEHELM

notes.title: ENDLOOP Minor update 2
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I've decided to release small update after feedback about the new hints. They broke the immersion and that was never their intention. The text hints are now gone, but the other updates made to the puzzles are still there. 

But that's not all, I've added an stairway extra puzzle and some other small events. 
I hope you enjoy them.

Here are the changes listed in the current update.


 Removed hint text since it was ruining the immersion of the game
 Added a new stairway puzzle
 Added multiple new horror events
 Fixed the final floor number to show the correct number


Cheers
Icehelm

notes.title: ENDLOOP Minor update
notes.content:
Hello everyone! 

I hope you are all enjoy ENDLOOP.

There has been some incredible feedback during these last few days and this has led to a few changes.

Here are some of the changes that has been done.


 All stairway puzzles have been updated to be a bit less cryptic
 Some stairway puzzles now have random spawning of items, this will make each run a bit less predictable.
 Some room puzzles have been updated with hints of how to solve them.
 Fixed an issue with the "don't look at me" puzzle
 Fixed minor general puzzle issues 
 Added a new random event


I hope these fixes will help some of you that are currently stuck.

Cheers and see you later
Icehelm

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.content: Small patch that should fix several issues with rooms acting weird and some people getting teleported to the last room.
